dedupe_keys.name: design oriented digital twin framework for optimal vsc setpoint synthesis in hybrid ac dc cigre low voltage networks

description: The documented offline design model synthesises voltage-source-converter setpoints in a modified CIGRE low-voltage hybrid AC/DC network with eight converters. It uses Python and PyDAE with Harris Hawks and particle-swarm optimisation, evaluates 24-hour hourly schedules and four loading conditions, and compares voltage and power-loss behaviour. The source calls it a design-oriented digital twin; live monitoring or an operational replica is not established.
